text:
jess: SAST job on  PR #4822 is failing with a weird 'unsigned-commit' finding. started at 11:07am staging CI.
raja: can you paste the pipeline log snippet?
jess: log: `git fetch origin +refs/heads/feature/fastpath:refs/remotes/origin/feature/fastpath` then `verify-commit-signature: no signature found for commit 7a1b2c3`. SAST treats unsigned commit as potential supply-chain alert.
tori: we rotated the repo signing key yesterday as part of KMS rotate `kms-rotate-2026-04`. might be related. security-bot flagged a suppressed audit write during the rotate window.
security-bot: ALERT: KMS audit writes suppressed for rotation run `kms-rotate-2026-04` at 2026-04-02T02:15Z. See infra run artifacts.
raja: if CI can't verify signature because the old public key isn't available or the verifier can't access KMS, SAST will flag everything. jess, does the repo show signed commits upstream?
jess: upstream has signed commits, but our clone in CI shows gaps. I repro locally by running `git verify-commit 7a1b2c3` against the CI git mirror and it fails.
infra-bot: note: repo-mirror svcacct had a temporary RBAC removal at 02:10 for `role:mirror-read`. change CR: mirror-0206.
raja: ok that's the link: RBAC removal + KMS audit suppression during rotation. hard to prove who triggered what without logs. we need audit evidence and a quick remediation so SAST unblocks.
tori: mitigation options: 1) restore mirror-read to repo-mirror service account (fast); 2) ship a fallback public-key bundle into CI container for signature verification (medium); 3) change SAST rule to skip unsigned-commit alerts for this PR (not ideal).
jess: prefer option 1 for immediate unblock. also we'll collect artifacts to prove this was infra change, not supply-chain compromise.
raja: assigned: raja -> restore RBAC for repo-mirror, jess -> collect CI job logs and git objects, tori -> export KMS rotation run artifacts and key metadata. target 45min.
infra-bot: Deploy: RBAC change mirror-0206 reverted by raja at 11:12Z. mirror-read binding restored for svcacct repo-mirror.
jess: re-triggered PR pipeline. SAST now passes signature check for commit 7a1b2c3 but there are two legacy unsigned commits earlier in the branch flagged by the rule. rebase suggested.
tori: grabbing KMS artifacts and audit logs for 02:00-02:30 window. security-bot: remember audit-write suppression means we should fetch additional sources: runner job logs, controller event logs, and cloud KMS admin timeline.
raja: I'll add a short-lived exception rule to ignore the unsigned commits produced before the key rotation, but only after we've captured evidence. won't relax rules permanently.
jess: uploading CI logs and git packfiles to https://artifacts.internal/redwood/sast/1762000456-pack.tar.gz (access: eng-security).
security-bot: REMINDER: open incident tracker if multiple security signals align. recommended: incidents/2026-04-02-sast-signing-rbac-kms.json.
tori: created incident doc and attached KMS rotation artifacts. linking in tracker.
raja: follow-up actions: (a) make repo-mirror onboarding resilient to short RBAC flips (b) add CI-side cached public-key bundle for verification fallback (c) alert on failed commit-verification >1 run.
jess: leaving thread open for any follow-ups. marking owners: raja (RBAC remediation / resilience), tori (KMS evidence), jess (scan artifacts). :white_check_mark:
